name: 363-hug
notes: #363 B7.d (behind BeatFlags.Hugs, default OFF; this clip forces it on so the user can see the variant): two people close in with arms wide, wrap (arms x85, z inward 10, squash .92, lean 10), a hit on arrival, hold 1.2 s swaying roll +-6 at 1 Hz (opposite signs: they face each other), step back 0.05 u with a tiny hop, arms drop. The second is the smaller one (a kid) and is lifted 0.02 u while held. knownGaps react: the bench only sees a doll answer by style, position or prop; the kid answers by wrapping its arms and squashing on the same frame (pose), after closing in by itself.
